revenue.source: Sanofi Q4 2024 release (30 Jan 2025) App.3 for FY2023/FY2024 (Opella restated as discontinued); Sanofi Q4/FY2025 release (29 Jan 2026) for FY2025 net sales 43,626

operating_income.source: IFRS operating income. FY2023 6,960 from Q4 2024 release (FY2024 shown there as 7,491); FY2024 7,252 and FY2025 6,344 from Q4/FY2025 release App.3 (FY2024 as restated there). Basis for FY2023 may differ slightly from FY2024/25 restatement. FY2025 includes €2,241m intangible impairments

d_and_a.source: Computed: D&A of PP&E and software (FY2023 1,509; FY2024 1,546; FY2025 1,434; Q4 2024 and Q4 2025 releases) + amortisation of intangibles (1,911; 1,749; 1,776; same releases). Excludes intangible impairments

capex.source: Acquisitions of PP&E and software, Q4 2024 release (FY2023, FY2024) and Q4/FY2025 release (FY2025 1,858, FY2024 1,808). Excludes acquired intangibles/R&D and M&A

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 6.2% reported / 9.9% CER; Dupixent-led growth expected to fade gradually toward GDP-plus as patent expiries approach; no company guidance used

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 IFRS margin 14.5% (6,344/43,626) is depressed by €2,241m impairments; ex-impairment 19.7%. Business operating margin ~27.8% (12,149/43,626) before ~4% amortisation. 20% chosen as normalised

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. Sanofi business effective tax rate guidance ~21%; not verified from a filing in this session

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 capex 1,858 / 43,626 = 4.3%, held flat (excludes intangible acquisitions)

wacc.source: Assumption: large-cap defensive pharma; beta ~0.6, rf ~3%, ERP ~5.5%, modest debt; no data provider used

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run euro-area inflation/nominal growth, conservative for pharma

net_debt.source: Sanofi Q4/FY2025 press release 29 Jan 2026: net debt €11,008m net of €7,657m cash and equivalents (Sanofi definition, excludes lease liabilities)

diluted_shares.source: Average shares OUTSTANDING (basic) 1,220.4m from FY2025 release App.3; FY2025 diluted average not found (H1 2025 diluted was 1,230.7m vs 1,225.5m basic, so true diluted is likely ~5m higher)
